department: Computer Science (College of Engineering & Applied Science)

deadline.value: The College recommends April 1 for Fall for international applicants; applications are otherwise rolling.
deadline.quote: we recommend the following deadlines to assure a timely response for the requested semester, especially for international applicants | Fall Semester – April 1

gre_general.value: The GRE is required for PhD applicants, domestic and international.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is required for all international and domestic applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; a program advisor is assigned at admission and a major professor is chosen later.
supervisor.quote: The incoming student will be assigned to an initial Program Advisor at the time of admission.

funding.value: Admission does not guarantee funding; top students may get fellowship or assistantship packages.
funding.quote: Although admission does not guarantee funding or financial aid, top students may be considered for attractive fellowship and/or assistantship packages.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's can be used; a bachelor's-only applicant must be exceptionally strong.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s or master’s degree: | Applicants holding a BS degree in computer science may be admitted only if they are exceptionally strong

english_waiver.value: The College's evaluators waive the English test for schools where English is the official language of instruction, after review; the catalog still says proof is required.
english_waiver.quote: UWM international evaluators/advisors are knowledgeable about which foreign schools have English as the official language of instruction and will automatically waive the requirement when reviewing an application.

notes: The catalog says international applicants must prove English; the College page says evaluators waive it for English-instruction schools. GRE is required by both.
